request: Objets trouvables : un sur six Pokémon sauvages battus ou capturés.
semantics: Independent 1/6 chance (16.6667%) per successful wild victory or capture, not a guaranteed sixth-encounter counter.

changes.chance: CHANCE = 1/6; ADVENTURE_CHANCE = CHANCE. Expedition Drift item-drop bonuses continue multiplying the base rate, capped at 100%.
changes.captureAdventure: A captured Pokémon is now an eligible successful outcome for the existing per-battle guarded SQL loot attempt. Summary, bagUpdated and narration use the existing item path.
changes.captureExpedition: capture and wild use the same item selector; finish guard already prevents duplicate capture/endbattle rewards.
preserved: Conditional weighted item families and individual rarity weights
Permanent unique-item discovery history, held and PC exclusions
One object attempt per battle; no item attempts for failure, escape or defeat
Separate Drift drop rate, collection bonuses and rarity
Money, XP, existing inventories, schemas and client assets

checks: Exactly 1000 successes among 6000 evenly spaced deterministic draws
Conditional family weighting, unique discovery and checkpoint preservation
Capture object granted once, summary contains it; duplicate finish grants nothing again
Separate Drift rate unchanged and deterministic test RNG defaults explicit
